main_measure.name: mean 20-bar fwd return in position minus all bars (non-overlapping blocks), t=1.102
main_measure.threshold: above 0 with t >= 2 to confirm; <= 0 rejects

supporting_check.name: share of positive 20-bar returns after up-crosses minus unconditional share

decided_by: Fewer than 15 non-overlapping in-position blocks (13) or fewer than 8 up-crosses (2), so the test neither confirms nor rejects.
reading: Blocks start at each window's first bar every 20 bars (block in position if forecast > 0 at its start), t is the one-sample t of in-position block returns minus the all-blocks mean, up-crosses are bars with forecast > 0 after a bar with forecast <= 0 in the same window, and the unconditional positive share uses every bar's 20-bar forward return pooled over all windows.
